summary: Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc battle for supremacy as Aston Martin's aggressive upgrade package threatens to shake up the midfield pecking order at the Hungaroring. Fernando Alonso's optimism about the team's new components could prove decisive in his contract negotiations with the Silverstone squad, adding intrigue to an already competitive weekend. A strong result here could cement Hamilton's championship momentum and signal whether Aston Martin's development trajectory positions them as genuine title contenders or mere pretenders to the established order.
